title: Tree pose

steps.text: Stand tall with your feet together.
Rest one foot against your other calf or inner thigh, not on the knee.
steps.cue: One foot on your calf or inner thigh, not the knee.

steps.text: Bring your hands together at your chest, or reach them overhead.
steps.cue: Hands at your chest, or reach up.

steps.text: Find a steady point to look at and take a few slow breaths.
steps.cue: Find a steady point to look at. Breathe.

steps.text: Lower the foot and change sides.

mistakes: Pressing the raised foot into the side of the knee.
regression: Keep your toes on the floor with the heel resting on your ankle, near a wall.
stopIf: Put the foot down if you start to wobble.

anatomy.why: The side of the standing hip keeps the pelvis level while you balance on one leg.

sources.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: 11.6 Appendicular muscles of the pelvic girdle and lower limbs
